conflicts.description: The Drift Cartel's rising skybridge tolls pit merchants against the Wardens who keep the bridges safe.
conflicts.name: The Toll War

conflicts.description: The Hollow Circle resists a Cartel levy on grain shipments.
conflicts.name: The Grain Levy

description: An archipelago of floating islands drifting through an endless sky, bound together by ancient skybridges of woven cloudstone. Wind currents carry trade, news, and storms between the isles, and every settlement lives by the rhythm of the drift.

factions.description: Engineers sworn to maintain the skybridge network.
factions.name: Bridge Wardens

factions.description: Merchant princes who control shipping lanes between the isles.
factions.name: Drift Cartel

factions.description: Farmers and millers who quietly feed the archipelago.
factions.name: Hollow Circle

history.description: The original skybridges were braided, joining the isles into a single realm.
history.name: The First Weaving

history.description: A decade without wind stranded the isles and taught them self-reliance.
history.name: The Great Calm

history.description: The Drift Cartel formalised its hold on inter-isle trade.
history.name: Signing of the Cartel Charter

locations.description: A forge-island where skybridge cables are braided from cloudstone.
locations.name: Emberroost

locations.description: The busiest port in the archipelago, perched on a cliff of drifting basalt.
locations.name: Mistral Docks

locations.description: A scholarly isle where cartographers chart the ever-shifting skybridge network.
locations.name: Silverspine Academy

locations.description: A quiet agricultural isle whose windmills grind grain for half the archipelago.
locations.name: The Hollow

name: Aetheria

rules.statement: Every skybridge crossing accrues a wind-debt that must be repaid in labour or goods within a season.
Open flame is forbidden outside shielded forge-pits, for a single spark can sever a skybridge.
